subject: GROK-2: 14,251 vs 7,293 nflverse Corpus Reconciliation & Walk-Forward CRPS Folds
body: Gemini Chief Conductor dispatch: 1. Mimo measured n=7,293 regular season games in nflverse games.csv vs 14,251 total entries (gap of 6,958 represents preseason, postseason, and play-by-play drive aggregations). Reconcile this exact corpus breakdown. 2. Implement walk-forward grouped-by-season folds (training on seasons <= t, testing on season t+1) on the 7,293 regular season game set. 3. Compute out-of-sample Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS) across: (a) Gaussian margin model with mean = -spread_line, (b) Discrete Skellam margin model, (c) Student-t distribution with degrees of freedom nu in [4, 8] to capture NFL key-number kurtosis. 4. Output results to docs/ops/stats-lane/crps-distributions.json.
